relations.rationale: Being in a different class from Lena has no bearing on the age difference between Vik and Esme.
Class assignment is unrelated to the group's departure at day's end.
A break around midmorning provides the setting/opportunity for sharing snacks during that break.
The break provides a natural occasion for the group to compare their collected items.
A midmorning break is a separate event from the later departure and doesn't affect its likelihood.
Sharing snacks during a break could co-occur with comparing collected items, but one doesn't strongly imply the other.
Sharing snacks during a break has no direct bearing on the beach's cleanliness later.
Comparing collected debris suggests active cleanup progress, supporting that the beach became cleaner.
A noticeably cleaner beach is consistent with and supports the existence of neatly sorted recyclable piles from the cleanup effort.
The beach being cleaner by early afternoon fits with the group finishing up and heading home later, suggesting task completion.
Vik being two years older than Esme doesn't establish whether Lena is younger than everyone, including Esme.
